---
name: "Survey / Research"
about: "Investigate a question or run a bounded experiment."
title: "[SURVEY] research(scope): state the question"
labels: "research"
---

## Why
State the research question or hypothesis.

## Outcome
What decision should the evidence inform?

## Scope
List sources or experiment inputs, controls, resource budget and stopping rule.

## Acceptance
State what observations or measurements would answer the question.

## Evidence
Record sources, findings, limitations, unknowns and the supported conclusion.
Research does not authorize implementation or production changes.
